title: Anchor-poster + Now/Next/Then card outputs
description: From the same generation, also output (a) an A3 Anchor Poster (the topic's key concepts as a printable display) and (b) a Now / Next / Then card (already exists for MTP — bring it to worksheets). Primary teachers will use these daily even on days they don't generate a worksheet.
rationale: User's improvement #17. Surfacing the existing Now/Next/Then helper at the worksheet level + a new Anchor Poster output means primary classrooms have a daily artefact regardless of whether the teacher hits Generate.
steps: Reuse mtp-v2-enhancements.ts buildNowNextThen (already deterministic, already shipped). Extract to client/src/lib/lessonOutputs.ts so worksheets can call it.
New helper buildAnchorPoster(worksheet, ko: KnowledgeOrganiser): { titleBlock; conceptMap; visualSlots; vocabRing }. Pure function, takes the worksheet + the KO from PD10. Renders to HTML.
WorksheetRenderer.tsx: add two more outputs to the existing 'Outputs' menu (or create one): Anchor Poster (A3) + Now/Next/Then card (A6 print).
Print routing through buildPopupHtml as elsewhere.
do_not_touch: MTP renderer (read-only consumer of the extraction)
acceptance_criteria: Outputs menu surfaces Anchor Poster + Now/Next/Then.
Both print as the right paper sizes (A3 landscape and A6).
verification: Manual: generate, click each output, confirm print preview.
